notes.title: v 1.0.1 Menu Window Hotfix
notes.content: Fixed an issue with the menu system where it would ignore the monitor the game was on when deciding it's position.

notes.title: Major Demo Content Update + Release Date Announced!
notes.content: [p]Hello all! [/p][p][/p][p]I want to thank you all again for looking into my little game! I've been hard at work improving the game and getting everything ship shape and ready for release! [/p][p][/p][p]Speaking of, the official release date for My Favorite Coworker is the 24th of September! The final version of the game will include achievements, a device customization, and 2 other pet evolutionary lines to work through![/p][p][/p][p]To tide you over until then, I have a host of updates I've made to the demo to improve gameplay! Please view the changelog below:[/p][list][*][p]Added a mood display system to give the player more insight into how well they are doing. [/p][/*][*][p]Updated Evolution Sequence to show a special display and wait for player input before continuing. [/p][/*][*][p]Pet's can now be named.[/p][/*][*][p]Food can rot if it's left out too long.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Pet's can gain special status conditions when receiving trauma, including conditions like Stinky, Hungry, Overstimulated, and Anxious.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]I hope you all continue to enjoy My Favorite Coworker and are as excited as I am for it's official release next month![/p][p][/p][p]-Aidan M.W. Barrett[/p]

notes.title: MFC Demo Hotfix v0.4.2
notes.content: [p]Hello all! I have worked on and fixed a handful of issues that were discovered after the demo released. On top of this stay tuned for an official release date being made public soon![/p][p][/p][p][b][u]Game Changes[/u][/b][/p][list][*][p]Improved Guess! minigame to have a high reward to account for random stat improvement [/p][/*][*][p]Pet will now look in the direction chosen in Guess! minigame[/p][/*][*][p]Improved game time modification options and added giga fast/slow modes [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b][u]Bug Fixes[/u][/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed issue with device minimization causing it to disappear when in any corner other than the bottom right [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue with device minimization animation snapping when minimizing from the top corners. [/p][/*][*][p]Prevented scenario in which the pet will attempt to eat air forever. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue with dialog windows opening off screen[/p][/*][/list]
